messages:
alejandro: Kicking off v2 rollout to gateway-canary (10%). Keep an eye on mobile and SDK routes. I'll watch metrics for the next 30m.

deploy-bot: rollout started: service=gateway env=canary percent=10 version=v2 started_by=@alejandro

zoe: seeing a spike of 400s from iOS SDK 2.1. Client header seems to still send X-API-Version: v1, server rejects with schema negotiation failure :eyes:

kevin: logs? sample?

zoe: pasted a curl that repros locally:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-API-Version: v1" https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v2/generate
# response: 400 {"error":"unsupported-client-version","expected":"Accept-Version: v2 or empty"}
```

mira: hmm clients should be able to downgrade gracefully. Is the gateway rejecting on header mismatch instead of falling back to v1 handling?

alejandro: It looks like our schema-negotiation flag is set to strict on the canary gateway. That was intended for compatibility testing but we might be too strict.

kevin: Quick mitigation options: 1) pause rollout 2) flip gateway to permissive negotiation 3) pin mobile routes to v1. Which is fastest?

mira: Pin mobile route to v1 for now (route=mobile/* -> v1). That avoids global rollback and buys time to fix negotiation logic. I can roll the pin.

alejandro: Good. Do pin + update release notes and SDK changelog. Also add a deprecation note in the response body so older clients get a friendly message.

deploy-bot: route-pin applied: route=mobile/* pinned_to=v1 by @mira

zoe: after pin, mobile 400s dropped to baseline. Native SDK teams pinged to update header usage.

kevin: For rollback criteria — propose: if global error-rate for v2 > 0.5% for 10m OR mobile client errors >1% for 5m -> trigger rollback. Thoughts?

mira: agree with thresholds. Also add: any 5xx spike (>0.2%) from gateway during rollout should auto-pause.

alejandro: agreed. I'll update the rollout runbook with those thresholds and call out the permissive flag change for the kernel.

ops-bot: scheduled check in 30m: thread=2289018000 action=review-metrics owner=@alejandro

zoe: once SDK teams ship a small fix (remove X-API-Version header or send Accept-Version), we can resume. For now leaving canary at 10% but pinned for mobile paths. :thumbsup:

alejandro: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short postmortem entry in the release notes explaining the negotiation behaviour and our mitigation. If anything regresses we'll rollback to v1 across the gateway.

mira: noted. I'll also add a small e2e test to the mobile integration pipeline to assert header negotiation fallback.

kevin: copying product and SDK engs on the postmortem.

alejandro: closing the loop — will escalate if metrics cross thresholds. :shipit:
